name: eval-harness
description: Operator-facing eval harness bundle. Runs scenarios + judges + regression gates against an agent under test (HTTP target or in-process function). Emits scorecard.json into .evolve/ for the project dashboard. Read-only against the router by default — does not need write capabilities. When deployed to a sandbox via the harness-aware deploy script, this agent reads scenarios/, judges/, and writes scorecards back to .evolve/scorecard.json.
